description: Validation set: a dynamically composed wrapper schema which validates messages containing both normal SDMX structures and instances of the custom structure definitions known to this system. It applies the SDMX-JSON structure schema to the message as a whole and, in addition, the dynamically generated schema of each known custom structure definition to the members of 'data/customStructures' which reference it. Each generated schema is referenced by the URN of the custom structure definition it was generated from, which is also the value the conditional matches on. The $id of this wrapper is arbitrary and local to the system which composed it; the urn:example namespace of RFC 6963 is used here because this is a sample. One conditional per known CSD version; instances of unknown CSDs are validated by the SDMX-JSON structure schema only (maintainable parts and reference to the definition) and are caught by referential integrity checking.
